relations.subject: Wilhelm Scherer
relations.evidence: He was educated at the academic gymnasium in Vienna and afterwards at the University of Vienna

relations.subject: Wilhelm Scherer
relations.evidence: at the University of Vienna, where he was a favorite pupil of the distinguished Germanist, Karl Müllenhoff (1818–1884).

relations.subject: Wilhelm Scherer
relations.role: privatdozent for German language and literature
relations.evidence: Having taken the degree of doctor philosophiae, he became privatdozent for German language and literature in 1864.

relations.subject: Wilhelm Scherer
relations.evidence: In 1868 he was named a full professor at Vienna

relations.subject: Wilhelm Scherer
relations.evidence: in 1872 received a call in a like capacity to the University of Strasbourg

relations.subject: Wilhelm Scherer
relations.evidence: and in 1877 to the University of Berlin
